auth_method.title: Authentication method
auth_method.description: How Polytomic authenticates with AdRoll: oauth or token (a personal access token).

client_id.description: Client ID of your own AdRoll application, used in place of Polytomic's.

client_secret.description: Client secret of your own AdRoll application, used with client_id.

personal_access_token.title: Personal access token
personal_access_token.description: AdRoll personal access token; required when auth_method is token.

advertisers.title: Advertisers
advertisers.description: AdRoll advertisers whose segments are available as sync destinations.
